process.title: Your path to the vehicle.
process.step_1_desc: Tell us what you're looking for — make, model, spec, budget. We advise you personally and find the right vehicle.
process.step_2_desc: We handpick from our network and personally inspect every vehicle on-site — including condition check and accident history.
process.step_3_desc: We handle the purchase contract, export documents and all logistics on the origin side.
process.step_4_desc: Your vehicle is shipped to Bremerhaven. We keep you informed throughout the entire transport.
process.step_5_desc: We handle the port, customs clearance and the full TÜV inspection per §21 StVZO — completely hassle-free for you.
process.step_6_desc: We register the vehicle in your name and deliver it directly to your door — road-ready with German plates.

reviews.title: What our customers say.
reviews.r1_text: From the first inquiry to delivery, everything was perfectly organised. The vehicle arrived registered and road-ready in just under eleven weeks. The standard equipment is on a level you simply can't find here in Germany.
reviews.r2_text: I was initially sceptical about whether an import could really work this smoothly. But the team proved me wrong. TÜV, registration, all the paperwork — handled completely on my behalf. My next car will come from Norvyn too.
reviews.r3_text: The value for money is simply unbeatable. The same vehicle with the same specification would have cost me significantly more at a German dealer. Communication was clear and transparent throughout.

faq.title: Everything you need to know.
faq.q1: How long does the import take in total?
faq.a1: You should generally plan for around 10–12 weeks from vehicle selection to delivery in Germany. The majority of this time is sea transport — the handling before and after is much faster.
faq.q2: Do I need to arrange TÜV and registration myself?
faq.a2: No. We handle the complete TÜV full inspection under §21 StVZO and registration in your name. You receive the vehicle fully registered — with no effort required on your part.
faq.q3: What costs come on top of the vehicle price?
faq.a3: Total costs consist of the vehicle price, shipping, import duty and import VAT. You receive a precise, transparent breakdown in your personal quote — no hidden fees.
faq.a4: We work exclusively with secure payment processing and clear contractual structures. No upfront payment without a written purchase agreement. Transparency and security come first.
faq.q5: Can I see the vehicle beforehand?
faq.a5: We personally inspect every vehicle on-site and document its condition with detailed photos and videos — which you receive before any purchase decision. Live video viewings can also be arranged on request.
faq.a6: We import handpicked vehicles from across Asia — from German premium brands with maximum specification to Asian manufacturers such as Genesis, Kia or BYD. If you have a specific model in mind, feel free to enquire directly.

about.page_description: We are Norvyn Motors — two entrepreneurs on a mission.
about.hero_subtitle: We believe the world's best cars aren't yet in every German driveway. We're changing that.
about.why_text: Manufacturers like Genesis, Kia and Hyundai — alongside Chinese pioneers like BYD, Xiaomi and NIO — have matched and often surpassed Europe's premium brands in technology, build quality and standard equipment. What was missing: a direct, transparent import route to Germany. That's exactly the route we're taking.
about.reason_1_desc: Asian vehicles lead in EV drivetrains, driver assistance systems and connected-car features — often years ahead of European competitors.
about.reason_2_desc: What's considered an expensive option in Europe is standard in Asia. Panoramic roof, heated seats, premium sound — included.
about.reason_3_desc: Same quality, lower price. We import directly from Asia and pass this advantage on to our customers.
about.khodyda_bio: With Café Jobst in Merzig, Khodyda Hassan proved that entrepreneurship is above all about one thing: the relentless drive to build something. As a founder and operator, he brings the energy and instinct that carries Norvyn Motors forward.
about.nico_bio: Nico Bäuerle didn't learn e-commerce at a corporation — he built his own projects from scratch, scaled them, and learned how digital markets really work. Cars are more than a career choice for him; they're a genuine passion. He knows the details, recognises the exceptional, and brings exactly that judgment to every import.
about.mission_quote: We don't import cars. We import a new way of driving.
